name: NB4
description: NB4 was a porter droid with masculine programming who was employed by the Rodian bounty hunter Slyder while on the starship Star of Empire. During the year 1 BBY, NB4, while performing his duties as a serving droid for the Star, encountered Lieutenant Kyle Katarn, a recently established officer of the Galactic Empire. Believing him to be a person of interest, NB4 reported him to Slyder.
